text_block_list.text:
Together we'll run for our dream! ♪ We'll
keep trying, and wring out
all our
strength! ♪
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: Wow, that was amazing! Both the race and the concert! My heart's still pounding!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I know, I know! And the best part of all
was...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Teio!
McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text:
Did you see Teio's final sprint? Her power
is incredible! She's second
to none!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
But McQueen had perfect pacing! She
stays calm and composed all
the way to
the finish line. No one else can compare!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Teio!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Well, did you see the way Teio's cute
ponytail flutters in the wind as
she runs?!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I was too busy staring at McQueen's
beautiful locks gleaming in
the sunlight!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Grr...
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look at those girls playing together.
How adorable.
text_block_list.name: Passerby

text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Anyway, let's just agree that they
were both incredible...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes! Both of them were really cool!
How could they not be?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Um... Aaand Токай Тэйо makes her move!
She puts on a burst of speed
to chase
down Мэдзиро МакКуин!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Is that an impression of the caster?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Yep! It's a little off though, don't you
think? Doesn't quite do Teio
justice.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
But we've only just joined the academy.
There's so much to learn! I'm
gonna
become just like Teio and my dad!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Your father... Oh, of course—he's a kind
man who everyone in town
loves, isn't he?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks for saying that. Yeah, I really
admire my dad. He always
puts other
people's happiness first!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Wherever he goes, he's always surrounded
by smiles. That's why I
wanna do the same
and make people smile with my running!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Just like Teio does too! I'm sure it'll make
my mom happy as well!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Though my reason's not exactly super
deep like yours, Dia!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I mean, you joined Академия Тайсен to
fulfill your family's wish, didn't
you?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Hmm, not quite. My family's wish—for me to win G1 races—is actually my dream too.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I was born thanks to the hopes and dreams
of many people—my
mother, my father,
and everyone connected to our business.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I want to meet their expectations and show
everyone my own unique
style of running...
just like McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: I see! Well, I know you'll be able to make your dream come true!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
You too, Kita! You'll make everyone
smile—I'm sure of it! That's one
of your
strengths, after all!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: Ding-dong, bing-bong...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wait, that chime... Oh no! It's almost
curfew! We have to hurry back to
the
dorm!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
No need to panic. I'll just call my driver...
Oh, I don't have my cell
phone.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Then let's take a taxi... Um, you don't
happen to have my wallet, do
you, Kita?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Nope, and I don't have any money on me
either! We'll just have to
make a run for it!
C'mooon!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: "I messed up again today. Why does this always happen to me? Sigh..."
text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Journal

text_block_list.text: "But it's okay! I'll have another chance with my next race. I'll push myself harder and definitely win the next one!"
text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Journal

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew, we're finally done. This place is way too huge for just two people to clean.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, it was the dorm leader's
decision, so what could we
do?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
"Quite brazen of you to break dorm curfew
so soon after entering the
academy. As a
tribute to your bravery, I'll reward you
both with a
week's worth of cleaning
duty."
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is that your impression of the dorm
leader yesterday? You're
really good at
impersonations, Kita!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I was so bummed out that it stuck
in my head. But whatever!
Cleaning duty
just feels like another part of school life!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Plus, you're here with me, Dia!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Huh? What about it?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Anything's fun when you're with your best
friend! I can't wait for us to
go running
together too!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I feel the same way. But—
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: WAAAAAH!
